messages:
maria: Hey folks — CI started showing intermittent failures in the GHAS Trivy step on main. It looks like the scanner worker tries to decrypt the KMS envelope and then the job hangs for ~2m before GHAS cancels the job. Not sure if this is KMS throttle, RBAC, or our runner concurrency. Anyone seen this pattern?

aj: Yep saw 3 flakes this morning. Logs show repeated `KMSDecrypt` retry attempts then `context deadline exceeded`. Might be transient KMS rate limiting from the runner pool.

maria: Pasted the snippet from the failed job log: 
```
2026-03-20T08:12:11Z scanner-worker-4 ERROR: decrypt failed: rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted desc = KMS api throttle
2026-03-20T08:12:12Z scanner-worker-4 WARN: retrying decrypt (attempt=3)
2026-03-20T08:14:13Z gha-runner-2 ERROR: step timed out after 120s waiting for scanner
```

devon: Two quick ideas: 1) add exponential backoff + jitter in the scanner KMS client, 2) allow the GHAS job timeout to be bumped for scan steps to 5m while we investigate. We already have backoff in some libs but maybe not in the decrypt hot path.

sec-bot: Automated alert: 3 scan failures in last 30m; correlated with high scanner-worker concurrency (pool=12 -> 24). See dashboard: https://internal.redwood/scanner/alerts/3402

aj: Also noticed an RBAC error earlier in one run: `access denied for decrypt: iam:PassRole` — might be a separate issue caused by an IAM role rotation that didn't apply to one runner.

maria: Good catch. We should treat these as two lanes: (A) KMS throttling/backoff and runner concurrency; (B) intermittent RBAC role-permission gaps. For (A) can we implement per-runner token bucket throttling so we don't hammer KMS? For (B) audit recent role changes.

harry: I can take (B). I'll audit the last 48h of role changes and check CloudTrail for `Decrypt` failures. If it's a rollout timing issue we may need to stagger role updates or add a fallback policy.

devon: For (A) I'll open a small patch: wrap KMS decrypt with a retry util that uses: `maxAttempts=6, base=200ms, multiplier=2, jitter=0.2` and instrument metrics `kms_decrypt_attempts` + `kms_decrypt_latency`. Also will add an opt-in throttling config `scanner.kms.max_inflight_per_runner` default 4.

sre-ops: If we add more retries, be careful with GHAS job timeouts. We shouldn't let retries cause GHAS to cancel the job before retries finish. Maybe extend step timeout to 5m as Devon suggested.

maria: Agreed. Let's do both: increase GHAS step timeout to 5m and add more granular metrics so we can see if retries actually reduce failure rate. Also add a feature flag so we can roll back quickly.

aj: On suppression rules — some scans are noisy because of dev dependencies we intentionally allow. Do we want to suppress these failures at the scanner (Trivy) level or keep them in GHAS and map with our suppression DB? Current suppression mapping is slightly out of date.

maria: We should avoid masking real decrypt/runner failures with suppression. But for known benign findings we should sync suppression lists. I'll schedule a suppression sync job post-patch.

harry: Update from role audit: looks like an automated job updated a service account IAM binding at 07:58 UTC; one runner picked up the old token and failed decrypts for ~3m until its instance refreshed credentials. So that's a rollout timing issue.

maria: Ok that explains the `iam:PassRole` flake. Harry — can you propose a mitigation? Staggered rollout or add tolerant permission for the decrypt operation?

harry: Staggered rollout is my recommendation. Also add a short-lived compatible fallback role (only decrypt) bound to the scanner instance group for 24h during rollouts. Will draft a minimal policy and rollout playbook.

devon: I'll open PRs for: (1) retry/backoff + metrics, (2) opt-in throttling config, (3) GHAS timeout bump (GHAS workflow change), and (4) feature-flag gate. PRs will include a test that simulates KMS ResourceExhausted and asserts retries back off.

sec-bot: CI note: created ticket SEC-4821 'GHAS Trivy decrypt throttling & RBAC rollout mitigation' assigned to devon, harry, maria.

maria: Timeline: devon — can you get a quick patch and GHAS timeout PR today? Harry — aim to have the rollout mitigation doc by EOD tomorrow. I'll coordinate suppression sync once we confirm scanner changes.

devon: Yes — patch and workflow PR today. Adding a note to change log. :thumbsup:

aj: I'll monitor dashboard and slack alerts and escalate if failures don't drop after PRs land.

maria: Great, thanks everyone. Closing the loop once PRs merged + one successful nightly scan. :white_check_mark:
